name: Satori
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: React-style flexbox layout to SVG without a browser; pairs with resvg for PNG
summary: Vercel library that converts a React-element tree styled with a subset of CSS (flexbox layout) into SVG, given font data. Runs in Node, edge runtimes or the browser. Output is SVG; rasterise it with resvg. Its strength is HTML/CSS-like layout for social cards and title images without a browser.
use_when: Title cards, thumbnails and social images from JSX-style layout; over Playwright when no browser is wanted
Batch stills driven by data, rendered to PNG via resvg
Flexbox layout for text blocks that you then convert to SVG
avoid_when: Full CSS (grid, many selectors, filters) or interactive content: Playwright with a real page
Motion: it produces a single still; use GSAP in a browser scene
Hand-tuned vector artwork: author SVG directly
notes: 2026-10-26: supported CSS subset and font format limits recalled from upstream docs, not re-read.

assessment.rationale: npm 0.63.2 published 2026-10-20 after 0.63.1 the same day; repository pushed 2026-10-23; MPL-2.0. Unique route from CSS-like layout to SVG without a browser. Pre-1.0 so APIs may change.
